The CRLF case works because I normalize line endings in the tokenizer. The implementation is complete. Let me give a summary:

## Summary

Built a complete IGES 5.3 reader/writer/evaluator in `/workspace/output/`:

**Modules:**
- `main.js` - Entry point with CLI dispatch
- `cli.js` - Five subcommands (parse, write, query, eval, roundtrip)
- `diag.js` - Diagnostic envelope helpers
- `sections.js` - Splits files into S/G/D/P/T sections, validates required sections
- `freeformat.js` - Hollerith-aware tokenizer + numeric/pointer/logical parsers
- `global.js` - 26-field Global section parser with delimiter detection (combinations 1-4), default resolution, and validation (positive numerics, prohibited delimiters, spec_version clamping)
- `directory.js` - 20-field DE parser with status-number unpacking
- `parser.js` - Wires sections + DE + PD into typed entity records, validates cross-references
- `entities.js` - Per-type parsers for all 87 supported entity types
- `entity_writer.js` - Per-type writers producing PD field arrays
- `writer.js` - File emitter with 80-col fixed-format layout, Hollerith-aware line wrapping, computed param_data_ptr/param_line_count
- `eval.js` - Parametric evaluation for curves (100/102/104/106/110/112/126/130) and surfaces (114/118/120/122/128/140/190/192/194/196/198), with full transformation-matrix chain composition

**Validation:**
- Tested round-trip stability on circle, line, B-spline, transformation, surface of revolution, cylindrical surface, label, multi-line start, trailing pointer groups
- Verified all error paths (negative type, unsupported type, prohibited delimiter, zero min_resolution, degenerate Type 110, missing Terminate)
- Verified eval correctness on circular arc, line + xform, B-spline curve, surface of revolution, cylindrical surface
- All emitted files are exactly 80 columns; second-pass roundtrip is byte-identical

## Summary

**Modules:**
- `main.js` - Entry point with CLI dispatch
- `cli.js` - Five subcommands (parse, write, query, eval, roundtrip)
- `diag.js` - Diagnostic envelope helpers
- `sections.js` - Splits files into S/G/D/P/T sections, validates required sections

- `global.js` - 26-field Global section parser with delimiter detection (combinations 1-4), default resolution, and validation (positive numerics, prohibited delimiters, spec_version clamping)
- `directory.js` - 20-field DE parser with status-number unpacking
- `parser.js` - Wires sections + DE + PD into typed entity records, validates cross-references
- `entities.js` - Per-type parsers for all 87 supported entity types
- `entity_writer.js` - Per-type writers producing PD field arrays
- `writer.js` - File emitter with 80-col fixed-format layout, Hollerith-aware line wrapping, computed param_data_ptr/param_line_count
- `eval.js` - Parametric evaluation for curves (100/102/104/106/110/112/126/130) and surfaces (114/118/120/122/128/140/190/192/194/196/198), with full transformation-matrix chain composition

**Validation:**
